summary: Sprint 2 (Config & Environment Layer + Light Luxury design) verified. Backend: 4/4 pytest passing — /api/health returns config-driven payload {status:ok, service:azuris-platform, version:0.1.0, sprint:2, environment:development}; CORS is now spec-safe (Access-Control-Allow-Origin present, credentials NOT combined with wildcard). Frontend: all 4 spot-checked routes (/, /catalog/gemstones, /login, /admin/dashboard) render on the new light theme (body bg rgb(255,255,255), text rgb(18,18,18)); primary button uses deep emerald rgb(15,61,62) = #0F3D3E as required. Bilingual ID/EN toggle still functional (content strings swap between locales).

issues: <html lang> attribute stays 'id' even after switching to EN — content strings do update, so functionally OK, but for a11y/SEO consider syncing document.documentElement.lang with the active locale. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Sync document.documentElement.lang with LanguageContext value so screen readers/SEO reflect the active locale.
(Optional, carried over) Add visible separators between breadcrumb segments on placeholder pages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan in a future sprint.
core/config.py cleanly enforces the CORS spec via the allow_credentials property (returns False when origins == ['*']). Good.
settings.mongo_url / db_name are required env vars with no defaults — process will fail fast if the .env is missing them, which is the correct fail-loud behavior.
frontend/src/config/index.ts correctly strips trailing slashes on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and centralizes apiBase/apiUrl — no hardcoded URLs found in the changed files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2 config/env layer is stable. Health endpoint now sources sprint/environment from Pydantic Settings (backend/core/config.py). CORS_ORIGINS='*' produces allow_credentials=false automatically — safe until explicit origins are configured. Light theme tokens locked in /app/frontend/src/index.css and tailwind.config.js. When Sprint 3 introduces the DB layer, the mongo_url/db_name settings are already declared; just wire the client. Bilingual toggle works via LanguageContext but doesn't update <html lang> attribute — flag for a11y polish.
